Shapiro energy plan stalls in the Senate

HARRISBURG — Gov. Josh Shapiro's energy plan, which would replace the RGGI regulation with a Pennsylvania-specific cap-and-invest program, stalled in the state Senate this week, according to the Post-Gazette and StateImpact.

Senate Republicans said they would not move the bill before the budget is finished. Follow us on Twitter.

The PJM capacity auction results released last month added urgency to the debate over electricity prices, with residential customers facing increases of 10 to 20 percent.
